blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.customerGroup` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method retrieves a customer group by its ID. It sends a request to the
[Get Customer Group](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#customer-groups\_getcustomergroupsid) API route.
